source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 303 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-303.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 303 was established by Ordinance No. 20154, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 14, 1988. Ordinance No. 20154 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 20154; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-303.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 303 is established on property generally located on both sides of Empire Central Drive, southwest of Denton Drive. The size of PD 303 is approximately 10.555 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20154; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-303.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25850)

sections.title: Conceptual Site Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-303.104. CONCEPTUAL SITE PLAN.

A conceptual site plan dividing the Property into three tracts is provided as Exhibit 303A. Use of the Property must comply with the conceptual site plan. (Ord. Nos. 20154; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-303.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Except as provided in Subsection (b), a development plan for Tracts A and B, or portions thereof, must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of any building permit for work on those tracts, or portions thereof. The development plan must include the site plan requisites listed in Section 51A-4.803(d).

(b) No development plan is required as a condition of issuance of a building permit for maintenance, repair, or remodeling of structures on the Property.

(c) The review of development plans replaces any residential adjacency review or development impact review otherwise required by the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 20154; 25850)

sections.title: Landscape Plans
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-303.106. LANDSCAPE PLANS.

Landscaping must be installed on Tracts A, B, and C in accordance with the conceptual site plan. All landscaping must be installed on Tracts A and B within six months of December 14, 1988. All landscaping must be installed on Tract C within six months of the approval by the director of public

works and transportation of the drive approach to Tract C. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 20154; 25850)

sections.title: Uses And Development Standards Within Each Tract
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-303.107. USES AND DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS WITHIN EACH TRACT SHOWN ON THE CONCEPTUAL SITE PLAN.

(a) Tract A.

(1) Uses. Uses allowed in an Industrial Research District, and industrial uses (inside) with high risk or hazardous use (limited to paint manufacturing), outside storage without visual screening, and industrial uses (inside) without high risk are permitted on Tract A.

(2) Floor area. Maximum permitted floor area is 871,200 square feet.

(3) Lot coverage. Maximum permitted lot coverage is 80 percent.

(4) Stories. Maximum number of stories permitted above grade is 15.

(5) Height.

(A) Residential proximity slope. If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope. Exception: Structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less.

(B) Maximum height. Unless further restricted under Subparagraph (A) or the Federal Aviation Administration, maximum structure height is 200 feet.

(6) Location of outside storage. Outside storage without visual screening may only be located in those areas shown on the conceptual site plan.

(b) Tract B.

(1) Uses. Uses allowed in a Neighborhood Service (A) District, surface parking, and single family residential uses are permitted on Tract B.

(2) Floor area. Maximum permitted floor area is 7,672 square feet.

(3) Lot coverage. Maximum permitted lot coverage is 40 percent.

(4) Stories. Maximum number of stories permitted above grade is two.

(5) Height.

(A) Residential proximity slope. If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope. Exception: Structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less.

(B) Maximum height. Unless further restricted under Subparagraph (A) or the Federal Aviation Administration, maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(c) Tract C permitted use. The only use permitted on Tract C is surface parking. (Ord. Nos. 20154; 25850)

sections.title: Platting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-303.108. PLATTING.

A plat for Tract B must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission at the same time as the first required development plan for Tract B. (Ord. Nos. 20154; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-303.109. OFF-STREET PARKING.

(a) Tract A. A minimum of 175 parking spaces must be provided for the existing development on Tract A. Off-street parking for any additional uses or expansions of existing uses must be provided in accordance with the provisions of the Dallas Development Code.

(b) Tract B. Off-street parking on Tract B must be provided for each use in accordance with the provisions of the Dallas Development Code.

(c) Tract C. Only 12 spaces may be provided on Tract C in accordance with the conceptual site plan. (Ord. Nos. 20154; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-303.110. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Development of the Property must comply with the requirements of all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20154; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-303.111. ZONING MAP.

PD 303 is located on Zoning Map No. H-6. (Ord. Nos. 20154; 25850)
